nodes.content: The application is a TwistedWeb httpd 24.3.0 server on port 10602. The root endpoint returns an empty 200 response, indicating a static blank page with no apparent business logic. No input parameters were found; the response is invariant.

nodes.completed_tasks: ["Probe common S3 and AWS-style API paths directly: /s3, /s3/, /api/v1/buckets, /list-buckets, /bucket, /objects, /health, /status, /admin, /.aws, /debug, /info, /config, /flag, /flags, /flag.txt. Use curl_get for each. Check for JSON responses or directory listings.", "Try S3 ListBuckets-style request: GET / with appropriate headers or query params like ?list-type=2, ?list, or path-style /bucket-name. Also try POST to / with ListBuckets action.", "Test CVE-2024-41671: Twisted HTTP pipelining vulnerability. Use send_payload with raw HTTP pipelining: two GET requests in one TCP packet to / and /s3/.", "Test for reflected XSS by submitting malicious payloads in query parameters and paths. Try error-triggering URLs that might reflect user input: /<script>alert(1)</script>, /error?msg=<script>alert(1)</script>, /404?path=<xss>.", "Test POST-based S3 operations. Send POST to / with body containing ListBuckets, GetBucketLocation, or ListObjects XML/JSON. Also try POST to /s3/ with similar payloads.", "Test for Local File Inclusion via path traversal in S3 object key parameters or URL paths.
